declare

begin

 -- get product type

 -- what type of discard type is this

IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :product_info.aliquot := substr(:product_info.product_code,7,2);
 go_item('product_info.aliquot');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 NEXT_ITEM;
 begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_discard_type = :g_discard_type_ot
 then
 begin
 select max(to_number(aliquot))
 into temp_aliquot
 from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and exp_date < sysdate
 and product_status = :g_product_status;
 exception

 then

 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_aliquot = 1
 then
 -- make sure this product has not already been discarded
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and exp_date < sysdate
 and aliquot = :product_info.aliquot;

 :s_product_code := '';

 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 :product_info.aliquot := temp_aliquot;
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 -- not an out date product
 elsif :s_discard_type in (':g_discard_type_bi',
 ':g_discard_type_nf')
 then
 begin
 null; -- for future handling of nft/bio
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 END IF;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_TRANSACTION

procedure commit_transaction is
begin

 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_PICK_SLIPS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure update_pick_slips is
-- if there are not any more products on this pick slip
-- close the pick slip, note their product status is 'OD'
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.X
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and product_status = :g_product_status;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- found no products for this pick slip so close the pick slip
 begin
 update pick_slips
 set pick_slip_status = :g_pick_slip_status_cl,
 program_id = :prog_name
 where chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id;
 exception
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_local_edate,v_local_time);

 begin
 select exp_date
 into v_local_edate --:product_info.exp_date
 from pick_slip_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and pick_slip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_pick_slip_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and aliquot = :product_info.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:product_info.coll_date);
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_local_edate,v_local_time); 
 :product_info.exp_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :product_info.exp_date := v_local_edate;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0308'); -- invalid exp_date
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODUCT_TYPE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_product_type is
 begin
---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
 select product_type
 into :product_info.product_type
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_info.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0309'); -- invalid product code
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PRODUCT_COUNT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_product_count is
 begin
 select count(unit_id)
 into :s_total_products
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = :s_pick_slip_id
 and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error('0200'); -- no products selected
 check_package_failure;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCT_INF_ALIQUOT_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select aliquot from pick_slip_products p where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id and product_code = :product_info.product_code and chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and not exists (select 'x' from discard_products a where a.product_code = p.product_code and a.unit_id = p.unit_id and a.aliquot = p.aliquot and a.coll_date = p.coll_date and a.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id) /*modified by hcl consulting*/ order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCT_INF_PRODUCT_COD_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct(p.product_code), v.product_type from vserv_products v, pick_slip_products p where p.unit_id = :product_info.unit_id and p.chapter_id = :g_chapter_id and p.blood_type is not null and exp_date < sysdate and product_status = :g_product_status and :s_pick_slip_id = p.pick_slip_id and not exists (select 'x' from discard_products a where a.product_code = p.product_code and a.unit_id = p.unit_id and a.aliquot = p.aliquot and a.coll_date = p.coll_date and a.chapter_id = p.chapter_id) and substr(p.product_code,1,5) = v.product_code and v.unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+365) order by p.product_code
